resume: Minimoog Model D emulation: three oscillators, ladder filter, contours, effects, arpeggiator and a 16-note sequencer, with 100 presets and 32 user slots.

commandes.role: Effects page (reverb, delay, chorus, drive); EDIT opens the effect's four parameters, FX again goes to the next effect.
In the FX page, opens the effect's four parameters.
Global settings: MIDI input, channel, pitch bend range, list of MIDI controls.
Saves the preset to a slot U01 to U32, after entering the name with the encoders.
One press turns the arpeggiator on or off; held, turns HOLD on.
Arms sequencer recording, up to 16 notes.

a_savoir: The panel has several pages (CTRL, OSC, MIX, FILT, F.ENV, A.ENV, FX); the documentation read does not say which button opens each one.
